primary_estimand: Genotype effect (Gprc6a_Mck-/- vs Gprc6a fl/fl) on muscle gene expression after a single bout of treadmill exercise; all sequenced mice were exercised
planned_contrasts: Gprc6a_Mck-/- vs Gprc6a fl/fl, both after exercise (S2.5.p1, S4.3.p1; paper reports no DEG count, names Il6 as most decreased (80%) and a modest decrease of Il6ra, Figure 6A/S6A)

exercise: after exercise only (no sedentary arm sequenced)

exercise_protocol: single bout, 40 min treadmill at 30 cm/s (S2.1.p1)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S4.3.p1 (RNA-seq details deferred to supplemental information, not available)

paper_method: not stated in main text (supplemental information)
paper_results: Il6 most decreased (~80%) in Gprc6a_Mck-/- muscle after exercise; Il6ra modestly decreased; other myokines unaffected
